subject.title: fix(cron): channel failure alerts drop when global webhook failure destination is set

question: Should a job-level failureDestination with a concrete channel and no mode override a global webhook mode as announce delivery?
rationale: The source and docs support this as a bug fix, but the PR changes an existing persisted-config resolution path that could affect users with stored channel-plus-global-webhook shapes.

options.title: Accept announce semantics after proof
options.body: Merge after real behavior proof if maintainers agree that a concrete channel without mode should follow the documented announce default even when a global webhook exists.

options.title: Require explicit mode preservation
options.body: Ask the contributor to preserve inherited webhook behavior unless mode is explicit, likely with docs or migration guidance for channel-shaped overrides.

options.title: Pause for canonical PR selection
options.body: Hold this PR while maintainers choose between this candidate and the older near-identical open candidate for the same issue.

recommendation.title: Accept announce semantics after proof
recommendation.body: Merge after real behavior proof if maintainers agree that a concrete channel without mode should follow the documented announce default even when a global webhook exists.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the original failure-destination feature and authored hardening commits in the same routing surface.
